home.description: TEKMESIS turns your question into an Evidence Report — real studies found, compared, and explained in plain language.
home.priceNote: CHF 9.90, one-time payment, no VAT shown (small-business regime / formation phase). No subscription.
home.priceAnchor: A wrong purchase or an ineffective approach usually costs more than CHF 9.90 — this report helps you know that in advance.

home.topicsTeaserHeading: Broad topic coverage, not just health
home.topicsTeaserIntro: Twelve life domains, from health to technology — pick a domain or write your own question.
home.howItWorksNote: No individual advice. Evidence-based orientation for personal questions.
home.sourceTransparencyBody: Every answer links to real, verifiable sources from recognized scholarly databases — never to invented studies.
home.trustBody: TEKMESIS is in closed beta. We deliberately collect little data, never sell reports for unsuitable questions, and disclose our limitations openly.
home.betaPositioning: TEKMESIS is launching with a small, closed beta of 15 people. Joining now means directly shaping the product.
home.refundNote: If your report can't be generated for technical reasons, that's detected automatically and refunded. For anything else, just get in touch — we handle it personally, with a response within 3–5 business days.
home.whyNotChatGptIntro: A chatbot answers almost anything instantly — the question is what the answer is actually based on. TEKMESIS is deliberately narrower and slower:

exampleReportPage.heading: Example Report

methodologyPage.heading: Methodology
methodologyPage.intro: How a TEKMESIS Evidence Report is built — step by step, transparent and traceable.

steps.title: Enter a question
steps.body: You pick a topic or write your own question.

steps.title: Refine the question
steps.body: TEKMESIS proposes a researchable phrasing, which you confirm or edit.

steps.title: Select data sources
steps.body: Depending on the topic, suitable scholarly databases are queried (see source routing).

steps.title: Search & screen studies
steps.body: Results are deduplicated, ranked by relevance and study design, and checked for eligibility.

steps.title: Assess eligibility
steps.body: Only sufficiently supported, comparable questions are offered as a report.

steps.title: Show the free teaser
steps.body: You see real search statistics, sources, and an initial orientation before you pay.

steps.title: Generate the full report
steps.body: After payment, the full structured evidence report is generated and validated.

methodologyPage.disclaimer: TEKMESIS provides general scientific information and evidence-based orientation for life questions. It does not replace individual professional advice.

sourcesPage.heading: Sources & Databases
sourcesPage.intro: TEKMESIS uses only official, verifiable scholarly data sources — no scraping, no paywall bypass, no copying of protected full text.

layers.title: Broad discovery
layers.body: OpenAlex — primary discovery graph across all 12 topic domains.

layers.title: Metadata verification
layers.body: Crossref — DOI and publisher metadata enriching every candidate record.

layers.title: Biomedical enrichment
layers.body: Europe PMC & NCBI E-utilities — for health-adjacent topics and questions.

layers.title: Content layer
layers.body: Abstracts and legally available open-access full text, where available.

sourcesPage.honestyBody: Every report states which sources were searched and which were unavailable, the search date, and known limitations. TEKMESIS never claims exhaustive coverage of the literature.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: TEKMESIS is built to collect as little personal data as possible.

sections.title: No mandatory account
sections.body: You can use TEKMESIS without registering. Access to a paid report is via a secure, non-guessable link.

sections.title: Input warning
sections.body: Please do not enter names, documents, or confidential personal data. For health topics: no individual diagnoses, medication lists, or health records.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Unpaid drafts: 7 days. Paid reports: 12 months, then automatic deletion. You can request earlier deletion at any time.

sections.title: Link sharing
sections.body: Anyone with your report link can view the report. You can deactivate the link yourself at any time.

sections.title: No raw questions in analytics
sections.body: We record anonymized usage events (e.g. "report ready"), but never the raw text of your questions.

sections.title: Processors
sections.body: Payments via Stripe, transactional email via Resend, data storage via Supabase, analytics via PostHog (EU region).

teaserPage.heading: Free Evidence Teaser
teaserPage.confidencePreliminaryNote: Preliminary, structural estimate based on study count and design — not yet a full content analysis (that arrives with AI-based synthesis in a later build step).
teaserPage.sourcesUnavailableNote: The following sources were unreachable during this search and are therefore missing from the results
teaserPage.screeningExplanation: Studies were selected by relevance, study design, and data completeness; retracted studies, pure study protocols, and topically unrelated matches were excluded.
teaserPage.limitationsNoticeBody: The evidence base for this question is currently limited. The full report makes these limitations transparent, but cannot deliver more than the available studies support.
teaserPage.noCoverageDisclosure: No claim of complete coverage of the scientific literature.
